export type AttrValue = string | number | boolean | undefined | null;

export interface DirectoryAddOptions {
    label: string;
    icon?: PluginIconName;
    className?: string;
    attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
}

export interface DirectoryPanelOptions {
    pluginId: string;
    embedded?: boolean;
    listLabel: string;
    body: string;
    className?: string;
    attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
    tools?: string;
    listRole?: "listbox" | "list" | "none";

    listAttrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;

    emptyInList?: boolean;

    addPlacement?: "start" | "end";
    footer?: string;
    label?: string;
}

export interface DirectoryRow {
    title: string;
    caption?: string;
    icon?: PluginIconName;
    count?: number | string;
    status?: string;
    statusTone?: DirectoryStatusTone;
    statusIcon?: PluginIconName;
    selected?: boolean;
    current?: boolean;
    hidden?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    density?: DirectoryRowDensity;
    href?: string;
    draggable?: boolean;
    trailing?: string;
    yield?: boolean;
    fileName?: boolean;
    className?: string;
    attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
    wrapperAttrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
}

export type DirectoryRowDensity = "compact" | "meta";

export type DirectoryStatusTone = MwStatusTone;

export interface MwButtonOptions {
    variant?: MwButtonVariant;
    size?: MwControlSize;
    type?: "button" | "submit" | "reset";
    disabled?: boolean;
    href?: string;
    loading?: boolean;
    icon?: PluginIconName;
    iconOnly?: boolean;
    label: string;
    key?: string;
    className?: string;
    attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
}

export type MwButtonVariant = "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger" | "danger-outline" | "link";

export type MwControlSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon";

export type MwStatusTone = "idle" | "progress" | "attention" | "hold" | "blocked" | "done" | "quiet";

export type MwTone = "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger";

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

type MwControlSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

interface MwInputOptions {
    name?: string;
    type?: string;
    value?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    invalid?: boolean;
    id?: string;
    describedBy?: string;
    size?: MwControlSize;
    className?: string;
    attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
}

interface RingSegment {
    points: number[][];
    alpha: number;
    z: number;
    tone: string;
}
